neighbours.label: a lone 'C'/'c' token that starts a word the tokenizer splits off (C|anker, c|ecidology, C|ressid)
fire: The old gardener showed us leaves damaged by Canker and explained how the fungus spreads.
Her thesis on cecidology examined the strange galls that wasps leave on oak leaves.
In the play, Cressida waits by the Grecian tents while Troilus watches from the walls.
We followed the river past the ruins of Cnossos before turning back toward the coast.
The pattern needed a crotch adjustment, so I pinned the fabric and tried it on again.
Researchers named the new beetle Ctenophorus after the comb-like ridges on its back.
His grandmother still cooks Czech dumplings every Sunday from her mother's recipe.
The museum displays a Cuneiform tablet that records a shipment of barley and oil.

We followed the river past the ruins of Mycenae before turning back toward the coast.
The pattern needed a waist adjustment, so I pinned the fabric and tried it on again.

notes: Card: ' C' 11, 'C' 9, ' c' 7, Cyrillic ' Ц' of top 32, each the first piece of a rarer word. The + pole also peaks on split ' c'/' C', so the distinguishing context is unclear.
